title: AC3 Twilio replay-window/timestamp rejection case is unimplemented and untested
evidence:
pub fn verify_signature(
  auth_token auth_token: String,
  url url: String,
  params params: List(#(String, String)),
  provided_signature provided_signature: String,
) -> Result(Nil, Nil) {

[handle_twilio_webhook flow: require_form -> Disabled check -> get_header("x-twilio-signature") -> verify_signature -> process_twilio_event; no Date/timestamp header is read and no age check runs]
detail: AC3 requires rejecting "(for Twilio) a stale/future-tolerant timestamp outside the replay window." The verifier takes no timestamp and the handler parses none — no Twilio replay window is enforced or tested.
recommended_fix: Either add a Twilio request-age check (validate the HTTP Date header, e.g. <=90s) with a rejection test, or amend AC3 to drop the Twilio timestamp clause if HMAC authenticity + idempotency is deemed sufficient defense-in-depth.

title: AC8 says entity_id = vacancy, but the notification is created on the reference_call entity
evidence:
dispatch(
    db,
    landlord_id,
    sql.ReferenceAwaitingCorrection,
    title,
    body,
    "reference_call",
    reference_call_id,
  )
detail: AC8 + Dev Notes 3/10 state "entity_id = the vacancy (join reference_call -> application -> vacancy)"; the row is created with entity_type "reference_call" + entity_id = reference_call_id. Mirrors notify_reference_unreachable; non-load-bearing (bell is a global per-user list, digest excluded by type).
recommended_fix: Confirm intended scoping. If vacancy-scoping is truly required for RC4.3, pass vacancy_id as entity_id (find_reference_call_by_send_ref already joins vacancy). Otherwise correct the AC8/Dev-Note wording to entity_id = reference_call_id.

evidence:

detail: AC1's terminal_reason example ("email_bounced/email_complaint/delivery_failed") and the new mark_awaiting_correction.sql docstring both say "delivery_failed", but resend_terminal_reason emits "email_failed" for email.failed — an internal slug mismatch rc3-7's referee_contact_invalid lens must align to.
